name: Indirect Observation Projection (Volumetric Rendering)
aliases: Differentiable Volumetric Rendering with Factor Fields
definition: A projection function $P$ for cases where only indirect observations are available (e.g., 2D images from a radiance field), extending $P$ to include differentiable volumetric rendering.
summary: Indirect Observation Projection uses differentiable volumetric rendering to learn 4D signals from 2D images, distinguishing itself by mapping view direction and spatial features to color and density via alpha compositing.
